ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (UIAF); Ley 1121 de 2006; Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. regime); Codigo de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971); Articulo 631-5 del Estatuto Tributario (Decreto 624 de 1989) as amended by Ley 2010 de 2019; Decreto 830 de 2021 (Registro Unico de Beneficiarios Finales - RUB); Circular Basica Juridica de la Superintendencia de Sociedades (Circular Externa 100-000021 de 2023) establishing SAGRILAFT obligations; Resolution UIAF standards for suspicious transaction reporting.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry of the shareholder's country of origin (e.g., Companies House, Secretary of State, or equivalent)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate resolution or board authorization of the foreign shareholder approving the incorporation of the Colombian S.A.S.
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors or equivalent governing body of the foreign corporate shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special Power of Attorney (Poder Especial) granted to the local incorporator or legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; consular legalization required for non-Hague Convention jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national identification of each ultimate beneficial owner and initial director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority or notary public of the home country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy; apostille or consular legalization when certification originates outside Colombia

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Certified translator or interpreter registered in Colombia
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certification by the designated translator before the Cámara de Comercio or competent authority

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence screening of all UBOs, shareholders, directors, and authorized representatives against OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UIAF national terrorist and money-laundering related lists, and Colombian domestic judicial/prosecutorial watchlists; Politically Exposed Person (PEP) identification at onboarding with ongoing transaction monitoring; obligation to file Suspicious Transaction Reports (ROS) with UIAF under Ley 526 de 1999 and Superintendencia de Sociedades SAGRILAFT regulations; negative news and adverse media checks required for low-risk EdTech subscription model.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Unico Empresarial y Social (RUES) - rues.org.co, operated through the local Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá at ccbb.org.co) for the online homonymy and name pre-approval request (consulta de homonimia)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be composed of Latin-script characters and generally readable and pronounceable in Spanish; the legal ending S.A.S. (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada) is mandatory for this entity type; Spanish accented characters are permitted; foreign words may be used only when they are not misleading, do not conflict with existing trademarks, and are expressible without transliteration into Spanish; no official transliteration certificate is required for names already in the Latin alphabet.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: COLOMBIA (when used to imply an official governmental connection)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The name pre-approval (certificado de homonimia) is valid for 30 calendar days and is not extendable; if rejected due to homonymy, the applicant must file a new consultation with a distinguishable primary token; if rejection is based on a prohibited or sensitive token, the entity may apply to the relevant sector regulator or the Superintendencia de Sociedades for express authorization; an administrative appeal (recurso de reposición) may be filed with the same Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days of the rejection notice under Ley 1437 de 2011, and a further appeal (recurso de apelación) may be lodged with the Superintendencia de Sociedades; as a practical fallback, a substantially new name is filed rather than litigating the administrative decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible with limitations: the registered office must be a real physical location within Colombian territory capable of receiving service of process and official correspondence; a P.O. Box alone is rejected. Virtual office arrangements are generally accepted by Cámaras de Comercio for low-risk knowledge-based businesses such as EdTech software, provided the virtual office provider issues an address certificate and the legal representative or administrator remains physically reachable during business hours; the address must also be declared to DIAN as the fiscal domicile.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; quantified risk of an unannounced physical inspection during the first year of operations is estimated at 5-10%. Cámara de Comercio inspections occur mainly upon third-party complaint; DIAN is the primary authority that may verify the registered and fiscal address during a tax audit, and the UIAF may indirectly trigger verification through financial institution KYC diligence. No sector-specific operating license is required for EdTech language learning platforms, reducing the likelihood of administrative site visits.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff (Decreto 960 de 1970 and current fee schedules)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory departmental rate of 0.7% on the declared capital amount, subject to minimum tariff for acts without estimated value

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille or consular legalization of foreign corporate shareholder documents (estimated for three documents)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff for certified registry certificates

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 1258 of 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Articles 1-5, 9, 17, 22 and 45; Colombian Code of Commerce, Articles 19, 110-115 and 143; Decree 1074 of 2015 (Commercial Registry Regulation).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — Registro Mercantil (Bogotá Chamber of Commerce, Commercial Registry Division).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (Private Incorporation Instrument); must be elevated to a Public Deed if in-kind assets or real property are contributed, pursuant to Article 5 of Law 1258 of 2008.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital. The incorporator freely fixes subscribed and paid capital in the bylaws; payment of the subscribed portion may be deferred for up to two (2) years from incorporation. No escrow or bank-lockbox account is mandated; cash subscriptions are evidenced by a deposit certificate annexed to the incorporation instrument.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE INCORPORATING SHAREHOLDER OF [CORPORATE NAME] S.A.S. 1. SHARE SUBSCRIPTION: The incorporation instrument's subscribed capital, comprising [number] shares with a nominal value of COP [amount] per share, fully or partially paid by the sole shareholder, [name], is hereby ratified and approved. 2. REGISTERED OFFICE: The Company adopts as its registered office the address of [street, city, department] for all statutory notices, judicial notifications, and corporate records. 3. OFFICER APPOINTMENTS: [Name] [ID no.] is appointed Legal Representative with broad administrative powers, and [name] is appointed as Secretary-Treasurer. 4. AUTHORIZATIONS: The officers are authorized to execute registration with the Chamber of Commerce, obtain the NIT, and perform all ancillary filings. Certified as a true and accurate record of the corporate acts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Availability Check and Reservation (Boletín de Homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ventanilla Virtual de Registros — Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá / RUES national portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the RUES virtual window, submit the name availability request identifying up to three proposed names, and pay the bulletin fee. Upon issuance, the selected corporate name (e.g., 'EdTech Language Learning S.A.S.') is reserved for 30 business days, ensuring exclusive use for the upcoming registration.
required_dossiers: Copy of the applicant's national ID (cédula) or passport
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the preferred name matches an existing registration, the system automatically checks the next candidate name on the same request; if all proposed names conflict, submit a new request with alternative names and pay a new bulletin fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Incorporation Instrument (Bylaws)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Sole incorporator (private instrument) or Notary Public (Notaría) when in-kind assets are contributed
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the SAS bylaws in Spanish specifying the corporate purpose aligned to ISIC 6201 (custom software development and interactive language-learning platforms), share capital structure, registered office address, administration rules, and legal representation. The instrument must be executed with the signature of the founding shareholder; when real property or regulated assets are contributed, the document must be elevated to a public deed before a notary who certifies the in-kind contributions.
required_dossiers: Incorporator passport/cédula and proof of address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarial intervention is required and flaws are noted in the draft, correct the cited clauses and re-execute within the 30-business-day validity of the name bulletin; a private instrument defect is resolved by submitting a corrected version signed anew.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Filing and Issuance of Existence Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil — Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (Commercial Registry and Certificates Division)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed incorporation instrument through the Chamber's virtual window or physical service center. Pay the mercantile registration tariff plus the registration tax on subscribed capital (approximately 0.7% of the declared capital). The registry reviews the document and, upon approval, issues the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal), effective from the registration date.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of registration fee and registration tax
Copy of the incorporator's identity document
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues observations or defects (observaciones), correct the identified issues through the virtual window within 10 business days and resubmit; the resubmission retains the original filing date when cured within the statutory term.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Registration (RUT) and NIT Activation with the DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN — Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (Virtual Office / Authorized Service Centers)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receiving the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation, file Form 1647 (Registro Único Tributario) online at the DIAN portal, declaring corporate status, ISIC economic activity 6201, registered address, and tax obligations (Corporate Income Tax, IVA, and applicable withholdings). The system validates the NIT already assigned to the company and issues the definitive RUT officially recognizing the entity as a taxpayer.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation of the company
Lease or service proof of the registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the virtual form is rejected, review tax-category, address, and activity mismatches, correct and resubmit; in case of interdiction (bloqueo) of the taxpayer ID, appear in person at the DIAN district office with the certificate and the rectified RUT for manual activation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Industry and Commerce Tax (ICA) and Ancillary Compliance Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda de Bogotá (Municipal Tax Administration)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company in the municipal ICA registry for the software services tariff (tarifa aplicable a servicios informáticos, typically 0.11%-0.67% of gross income as applicable) and formally register with the municipal workplace authority. Verify the need for the civil defense (fire safety) certificate, which is applicable only if a physical office facility is leased or opened.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal system reports an incompatible CIU/ISIC tariff code, file a rectification with supporting registration documents; if the ICA tariff allocated is incorrect, adjust the rate through an amendment in the municipal virtual tax mailbox.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — virtual language-learning software and digital services are not an industrial manufacturing activity; no industrial board registration is triggered at the national level.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — the Commercial Registry certification and RUT constitute the general commercial operating credentials; no separate industrial operating permit is issued for ISIC 6201 activities.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: ANLA — Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — EIA not required; software platforms generate no pollutant emissions, discharge, or physical waste.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable — no industrial effluent or gaseous emissions are generated. If physical premises exist, office waste handling must comply with urban solid waste regulations under Decree 1076 of 2015 and municipal sanitation bylaws.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Occupational health and safety (SST) compliance under Resolution 0312 of 2019 applies from the first employee. Fire-safety certification from the Fire Department (Cuerpo de Bomberos) and structural load clearance are required only if a physical office is opened, not for remote-only operations. As a low-risk (Riesgo I) occupation, a standard workplace security and evacuation plan suffices.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direccion de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); official web portal: www.dian.gov.co; electronic services access via the DIAN Transaccional portal (SIE) using a digital certificate (certificado digital) issued by authorized certification entities from the ONAC list.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Register the S.A.S. deed and bylaws with the local Chamber of Commerce (Camara de Comercio) to obtain the private registration number; 2) Within 30 days, apply to DIAN via the RUT (Registro Unico Tributario) electronic process for the NIT (Numero de Identificacion Tributaria); a foreign beneficial owner must provide a valid passport, proof of registered office abroad, and appoint a local legal representative with Colombian tax residence; 3) Obtain and activate the electronic signature (firma electronica) and digital certificate, and designate an authorized accountant (contador publico) for SIE filing; 4) If the entity will render services outside Colombia, the RUT must be updated to include the activity code for 'exportador de servicios' before issuing zero-rated invoices; 5) If the S.A.S. opts for the SIMPLE regime, an additional registration must be completed in the Administration module of DIAN before the annual option deadline.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: 1) Optional Regimen Simple de Tributacion (SIMPLE): election available for S.A.S. entities with gross annual revenues below COP 3,500 million (2024; the threshold is updated annually); combines income tax, VAT, and industry/trade tax into a sliding gross-revenue rate from 1.8% to 14.5%; cannot be revoked before the minimum 2-year period; 2) No Check-the-Box election exists; Colombia does not have an entity classification election for corporations; S.A.S. is mandatorily a separate tax subject taxed on worldwide income at 35% corporate rate (2025: 35%, plus a 3% surtax for certain high-revenue years, and a 7% or 9% permanent establishment surcharge in applicable cases); 3) Optional VAT grouping (Grupo de entidades) is not available for S.A.S. as it is reserved for joint venture contracts (CUFs) and business consortia meeting the 50% equity control test; 4) Hybrid mismatch elections are not expressly codified for local law; Colombian transfer pricing rules (Chapter III of the Tax Code) must be reviewed for cross-border hybrid instruments; 5) Foreign tax credit election is available per-treaty or unilateral under Article 254, at the taxpayer's option.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas), ie, the value added tax administered by DIAN under the Colombian Tax Code (Articles 420 et seq.); no separate sales-and-use tax exists.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary threshold applies for domestic S.A.S. entities performing taxable VAT activities: registration in the RUT and charging of IVA is mandatory from the first day of business. For foreign digital service providers (no local establishment), DIAN requires VAT registration and collection on B2C sales once their total Colombian digital service sales exceed COP 3,100 million per annual period (Decree 1416 of 2021); below that, they may voluntarily register. For the SIMPLE regime, the annual gross revenue cap is COP 3,500 million.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory Factura Electronica de Venta (FEV) with real-time DIAN validation for all registered taxpayers; issuance requires the FEV via the DIAN web service (Servicios Informaticos), API integration (JSON/XML), or an authorized technological operator (proveedor tecnologico); the invoice must be electronically transmitted to the DIAN prior to delivery to the purchaser and must contain the mandatory CUFE/CUDS hash and QR code; a separate numeration authorization is not required, but the RUT and digital certificate must be active; interim documents (e.g., proforma, 'cuenta de cobro') are forbidden for sales to final consumers; DIAN resolution No. 000165 of 2023 governs the 'Validacion Previa' (pre-validation) scheme, under which the DIAN must return an XML acknowledgment with the 'documento equivalente' status before the document is legally binding; invoices below COP 5 UVT (~COP 233,000 in 2025) may be substituted by simplified receipts (tiques) if issued through an approved fiscal registry (registraduria elevada).

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A Colombian S.A.S. may invoice services at 0% VAT (excluded/export services) when: a) the service is performed, developed, or provided from Colombian territory; b) the service is effectively used, consumed, or exploited exclusively outside Colombia, even if partially delivered electronically; c) the sale is made to a non-resident entity or to an entity operating in Colombia that is a special 'maquila' zone or a foreign-domiciled beneficiary; d) the service is not embedded in or added to the purchase price of tangible goods that will be consumed in Colombia. For EdTech subscription software sold via Apple IAP / Google Play Billing: if the platform operator (Apple/Google, as a foreign digital intermediary) purchases the license from the Colombian S.A.S. for redistribution to global users, the supply qualifies as an exported service; however, if the end user is located in Colombia and the platform collects VAT, the Colombian S.A.S. must NOT charge VAT twice, and the supply to the platform is treated as a VAT-neutral B2B export subject to zero-rating documentation. Zero-rated services must be declared in Form 300 (IVA) but do not generate output VAT; input VAT is creditable (descontable) only if the export service is evidenced by a valid export certificate. The S.A.S. must complete the 'exportador de servicios' registration in the RUT and, for services, sign the service export declaration (Declaracion de Exportacion de Servicios) under Resolution 031 of 2019.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration for services (Declaracion de Exportacion de Servicios - DES) validated by the DIAN Customs Office when the service is classified as an export; for pure digital services without physical customs movement, an 'export certificate' (certificado de exportacion) issued by the DIAN is acceptable
Commercial invoice or FEV (Factura Electronica de Venta) detailing the service, the contractual clause on exclusive foreign use, and the 0% VAT rate
Written service agreement (contrato) identifying the foreign beneficiary, its tax residence, and the place of use of the service
Proof of payment from abroad: inbound wire transfer credit advice (comprobante de transferencia) or confirmation from the foreign counterparty's bank
Foreign beneficiary tax residence certificate (certificado de residencia fiscal) issued by the foreign tax authority, or sworn statement if no tax treaty applies

Inward Remittance Certificate (Fondo de Inversion de Remesas, i.e., the 'certificado de no repatriacion' is not required; the DIAN requires the forex reimbursement voucher demonstrating the funds entered the national exchange market through an authorized intermediary broker)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may audit zero-rated export invoices within a 5-year statute of limitations. If the zero-rating is deemed fraudulent or unjustified, the tax authority will retroactively assess the 19% IVA plus default interest (calculated at the Banco de la Republica's lending rate from the original due date) and impose: a) a penalty of up to 200% of the omitted tax (Article 648 of the Tax Code) for inexact declarations; b) an additional penalty of up to 100% of the tax for repeated infractions; c) criminal liability under Article 402 of the Penal Code for 'falsedad en documentos privados' if the export documentation is falsified, with imprisonment from 48 to 108 months in aggravated cases; d) the export qualification is void if the foreign exchange is not repatriated within the 180-day statutory term (extendable only in cases of force majeure or with prior authorization from the Banco de la Republica); failure to repatriate triggers a fine of up to 10% of the non-repatriated amount and loss of the zero-rated treatment, converting the supply into taxable local services; e) directors and legal representatives may be jointly liable for the payment of the contested tax if they sign inexact declarations.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (the Central Bank of Colombia), exercising exchange-control powers jointly with the Ministry of Finance and Public Credit under Law 9 of 1991 and External Resolution No. 8 of 2000, as amended; daily enforcement of the regulated exchange market (Mercado Cambiario) is performed by Authorized Exchange Intermediaries (Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario, IMC), while DIAN receives the ancillary tax-filing data.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) is freely convertible for current-account flows, but Colombia does not maintain full capital-account freedom. Inward direct investment, external loans, repatriation of capital, dividends, royalties, and service payments must be routed through an IMC and evidenced by a Declaración de Cambio. The EdTech revenue stream from Apple IAP and Google Play Billing qualifies as an export of services and is convertible without prior central-bank authorization, provided the proceeds are channeled through an IMC in accordance with the statutory deadlines. Dividend and profit remittance is lawful after the foreign investment has been registered with Banco de la República (Formulario No. 3 – Inversión Internacional) and applicable dividend withholding tax has been satisfied; unregistered investment forfeits the procedural right to obtain foreign exchange for remittance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Colombia imposes no mandatory percentage surrender and no forced conversion of export receipts; however, the full amount of service-export proceeds (including digital education subscriptions settled by app stores) must be repatriated and channeled through the IMC system. The statutory channeling window is six months for services and up to twelve months for goods; software products and technology-enabled education services may, upon proper classification, access the extended window. The proceeds may be retained in a foreign-currency deposit account with an authorized bank in Colombia or a registered foreign compensation account (cuenta de compensación), but channeling must be completed and evidenced in the applicable Declaración de Cambio. Late or omitted channeling gives rise to administrative sanctions and, where foreign assets are not declared to DIAN, to tax and foreign-wealth penalties.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational multicurrency current account (Cuenta Corriente COP with USD component) and treasury concentration account
FDI channeling account (Formulario No. 3 Inversión Internacional) and segregated capital-transit account
Operational account for payroll, disbursements, and digital collections clearing
USD-COP dual-currency treasury account with dedicated FX hedging line
Group liquidity sweep and cross-border liquidity concentration account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Regulated Colombian financial-technology channels are viable: licensed electronic payment and digital-deposit companies (Sociedades Especializadas en Depósitos y Pagos Electrónicos, SEDPE) such as Nequi and Daviplata can serve as domestic collection and disbursement front-ends. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Payoneer, Mercury, and similar neobanks) have no regulated bank status in Colombia and cannot satisfy IMC channeling. Their viability is limited to temporary USD aggregation of Apple and Google store payouts before a regulated sweep into Colombia, with an overall feasibility rating of Medium for collection support and Low for any treasury, FX, or clearing function.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A first-time, non-resident-owned S.A.S. must present its legal representative for an in-person interview at the selected financial institution; a purely remote opening is not generally available. If the legal representative is abroad, the entity may execute a notarized and apostilled power of attorney (poder general) in favor of a Colombian-resident individual who attends the interview and signs the account agreement. Video-identity verification supplements but does not replace the physical interview for original onboarding in most Tier-1 banks; bank-specific policy may permit remote signing with advanced digital certificates and biometric verification only for fully digital products lacking a treasury component.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial owners organized through a U.S. or Panama holding vehicle without a Colombian tax ID (NIT) and with opaque ownership layers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled constitutional and corporate documents of each holding entity; register the S.A.S. and its UBOs with DIAN (RUT/NIT) and Camara de Comercio; complete the DIAN Beneficiario Final declaration under Law 2010/2019 and Law 2277/2022; provide an ownership chart with percentages, certificates of good standing, directors' ID copies, and an economic-substance report covering Colombian premises, payroll, and EdTech-related contracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Early-stage S.A.S. with minimal paid-in capital receiving large commercial proceeds from Apple/Google Play without documented customer contracts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: App Store Connect and Google Play Console payout statements, monthly settlement reports, end-user license metrics, vendor agreements with Apple Distribution International and Google, a cash-flow forecast for the first 12 months, and a documented fraud-and-money-laundering risk assessment of the subscription business model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Shell indicators: no Colombian resident statutory representative, no local operating expenses, and concentrated inbound wire transfers from foreign entity accounts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Appointment of a Colombian manager or legal representative registered at Camara de Comercio; employee or BPO service agreements, social-security filings (EPS, ARL, caja de compensación), lease agreement for Colombian office space, and local tax filings (ICA, withholding returns) demonstrating real economic activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cancellation or intense transaction-velocity mismatch between declared digital education revenues and actual app-store net settlements.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Three-way reconciliation model linking App Store Connect and Google Play data to bank receipts, export-service declarations, and DIAN VAT/withholding returns; commission-to-net payout schedules; chargeback and refund reports; and audited or management financial statements.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Non-resident shareholders must wire the capital contribution in USD to the S.A.S.'s account with an IMC bank. The wire must identify the beneficiary NIT, the S.A.S. name, the SWIFT BIC of the Colombian institution, and the narrative 'FDI capital contribution to Colombian S.A.S. (Código 1020)'. The bank prepares the Declaración de Cambio (Formulario No. 3 – Inversión Internacional) within five business days of receipt; the completed registration certificate must be retained as proof of investment for future dividend repatriation and capital refunds. Parent-loan disbursements must instead follow the external-debt channel: register the credit with Banco de la República where the aggregate facility exceeds the statutory threshold, present the external-debt declaration at disbursement, and comply with the minimum stay and registration covenants before servicing interest and principal.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103 for contractually documented cross-border IP licensing, trademark royalties, and software vendor payments; use MT202 covers for liquidity concentration. For reconciled local disbursements (payroll, colocation, marketing, and taxes), clear through ACH Colombia or Redeban networks for low value and through the SEBRA RTGS system for high-value COP transactions; pay DIAN and municipal ICA through bank-integrated PSE or SIE screens. For Apple and Google collections, instruct app-store payouts to a U.S.-dollar account linked to the IMC bank, or to the SAS's registered compensation account, and sweep the USD balance into Colombia within the 6-month service-export channeling window. Dividend and royalty remittances to the foreign parent are executed through the same IMC structure using the corresponding dividend/royalty exchange codes and certification of paid corporate income tax.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla USD/COP deliverable or cash-settled FX forwards contracted with an authorized IMC for up to 100% of the forecasted Apple/Google collections under a board-approved, non-speculative hedging policy.
USD/COP cross-currency swaps aligned with the payment profile of the intercompany parent loan (capital and interest servicing).
OTC USD/COP call and put options, including zero-premium collars, executed solely to protect the company's net USD surplus exposure.

Offshore USD/COP non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) admissible only where no adequate domestic forward exists, entered with a reputable international bank, limited to hedging, and fully disclosed in the exchange-control documentation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Mercantile Registry Renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio principal (Chamber of Commerce)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than March 31 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers a fine equivalent to 2.5% of the renewal fee; persistent non-renewal for more than 6 months may lead to suspension of registration and eventual strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statement Filing (Depósito de Estados Financieros)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio principal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after shareholder approval; approval must occur by March 31, file no later than April 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines imposed by the Superintendencia de Sociedades up to 2,000 SMMLV permitted; unapproved accounts prevent lawful dividend distribution

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar window between early April and mid-May depending on last NIT digit (specific dates announced annually)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fines from 1% to 5% of taxable value or basis, plus default interest; continuation may block tax residence certificate

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Owner Update (Actualización del Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUB)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month following the annual income tax return filing, year‑over‑year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of up to 3,800 UVT for non‑compliance; per day of delay may be applied

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent statutory audit (Revisor Fiscal) is mandatory when total assets or gross income exceed 5,000 SMMLV (approx. USD 1.5m), or when the company is of public interest of controlled/parent of a group, or when more than 30% of shares are held by public entities.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Colombia (NIIF) – full version for larger entities, simplified IFRS for small and medium‑sized entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: An annual confirmation of the ultimate beneficial owners must be filed with DIAN as part of the RUB; any share transfer, direct or indirect, that affects the ownership map or control structure of the SAS must be reflected in this annual update and also reported to the Chamber of Commerce within the annual renewal.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas (Shareholders’ Meeting Minute Book)
Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva (Board of Directors’ Minute Book, if board exists)
Registro de Accionistas / Comprobante de Acciones (Share Registry and Stock Ledger)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 – 900 per annum (registered agent and virtual office service)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 – 8,000 (voluntary audit, required only if statutory thresholds met)

stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions
